# PMFBY APIs

[Grievance contract and examples](grievance/v0.2/) describe the proposed grievance integration. It does not cover grievance OTP initiation and verification.

[Policy and claim lookups](insurance/v0.2/openapi.yaml) describe the two native reads the adapter makes after authentication. Neither document is an official PMFBY specification.
